semiconductor_relevance: High — MTI Co., Ltd. specializes in chemical solutions for the semiconductor industry, providing essential materials for various processes.
summary: MTI Co., Ltd. is a chemical liquid manufacturing company focused on the semiconductor industry, offering products such as surface active agents for silicon dust prevention, sawing process solutions, and de-flux cleaning solutions. The company also develops customized products to meet specific customer demands, ensuring high-quality materials for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Surface active agents for silicon dust prevention

regional_presence.Asia: MTI provides stable and innovative materials to many semiconductor companies in Asia.
